question: Consider two samples of the same metal, Sample X and Sample Y. Sample X has a highly polished, clean surface, while Sample Y has a rough, oxidized surface. How would their work functions compare?

options.A: They would have the exact same work function because they are the same element
options.B: Sample X would likely have a lower work function than Sample Y due to surface purity
options.C: Sample Y would have a lower work function because oxidation adds energy
options.D: The work function is independent of surface conditions
